admission.justification: Realized across paseo_bridge.mjs, paseo_bridge.py, paseo_catalog.py, and role_launch_preparation.py, and proved by test_paseo_catalog_preparation.py, test_paseo_launch.py, and test_paseo_bridge_catalog_freshness.py.

applicability: Server operations inside launcher_catalog_question() (metadata /api/role-launch/options and /api/role-launch/dispatch preparation).
conditions: readCatalog metadata mode returns a launcher-scoped daemonConfig projection (agentProfiles and per-provider options/params for extraArgs and supportsMcpServers, excluding provider env maps) or an explicit daemonConfigError.

launcher_daemon_configuration() stores the answer in an operation-scoped ContextVar cleared on exit, and recorded errors propagate as unavailable/DAEMON_CONFIG_UNVERIFIED without spawning fallback bridge calls.
exclusions: No cross-operation or process-lifetime cache is introduced (INV-RQ2ZB8 preserved); callers outside launcher_catalog_question() or replies omitting both fields retain direct bridge calls.
statement: One metadata bridge call supplies catalog, role profiles and daemon configuration within each launcher operation.
title: One metadata bridge call supplies catalog, profiles, and daemon config
